The hydrodynamic diameters of PS-COOH NPs and PS-NH2 NPs in the nutrient solution were 156.43 ± 0.91 nm and 196.28 ± 5.79 nm, respectively, with zeta potentials of -24.47 ± 0.15 mV and 19.86 ± 0.32 mV. || The zeta potential and hydrodynamic size of NPs in water and nutrient solution were characterized using a Zetasizer Nano (Malvern Instrument Ltd., Worcestershire, Zetasizer Nano ZS90, UK).
